Hi everyone, I have a question for Israeli/mixed couples who registered their marriage in Israel.
I’m Romanian and I’m currently in Israel. During my visa process (started the process March 2025 and got my b1 august 2025- Hadera Branch),I already submitted my certificate of celibacy/personal status with apostille and translation. I have not left Israel since , and we got married in Utah (Zoom marriage) in June 2026.
Now, when my husband tries to register our marriage at Misrad HaPnim, they are asking again for my certificate of celibacy.
Has anyone experienced this? Did you also have to get a new certificate even though it was already submitted during the visa process?

+ After my husband’s attempt to register the marriage in mh, he also sent them an email about this and in addition to this they asked for a police clearance from my home country too(i thought this is only needed at the beginning of the process)
